thread:
olivia: Heads up - Partner 'Edge Supplier' flagged a discrepancy: their hourly usage file sums to 12345.67 units but our ledger shows 12346 due to rounding. Customers seeing small cents differences in invoices.

mark: can you paste the partner file sample? is this a rounding vs unit-conversion issue?

edge-supplier: sample excerpt (sanitized): ```csv
device_id,timestamp,units
ES-1001,2026-03-22T10:00:00Z,0.3333
ES-1001,2026-03-22T10:01:00Z,0.3333
ES-1001,2026-03-22T10:02:00Z,0.3334
```

currency-team: our billing pipeline stores units as integer "micro-units" (units * 1e6) and sums at aggregation then converts back with bankers rounding to 2 decimal places for invoice. if partner rounds their hourly to 2 decimals before sending, small diffs occur.

olivia: so partner sent rounded hourly aggregates, we re-summed minute-level raw -> tiny diff. what's the quick fix?

mark: short-term: on ingest, detect if partner declares "preaggregated=true" and then use their provided aggregate as authoritative instead of recomputing. add a signed-aggregate header to ensure integrity.

devops-bot: created PARTNER-3521: "Edge Supplier preaggregated vs raw ingestion rounding policy" assigned to mark. https://redwood.internal/partners/3521

currency-team: medium-term: standardize partner contract to state canonical storage unit = micro-units and require partners to send integer micro-units OR include a checksum and indication of rounding method. update onboarding checklist.

edge-supplier: we'll change our exporter to send micro-units and add "source_precision": "micro". ETA 48h.

olivia: also add a monitoring alert that triggers when absolute(invoice_units - partner_units) > 0.01 for any partner-hour window so we catch regressions.

mark: tests: create integration case where partner sends preaggregated 12345.67 and raw minutes sum to 12345.6666 -> ensure behavior respects preaggregated flag and ledger matches partner-provided amount. add test at integration/partners/edge-supplier/rounding.spec.ts.

olivia: communications: we should notify affected customers if correction > $1. small diffs can be auto-adjusted in next billing cycle; include note in partner playbook.

edge-supplier: thanks — we'll push micro-unit exporter and signed-aggregate within 48h and pause replays until validated.

mark: follow-ups: 1) implement preaggregated detection + trust path, 2) update partner onboarding contract language, 3) add monitoring alert. I'll own the work.

olivia: meeting after standup to confirm rollout plan. :white_check_mark:
